name: Nyan Nyan Shichau!
original_name: ニャンニャンしちゃう！
source:
Main character awakens on a fluffy bed in a cat country after breaking up with his girlfriend. It looks like he has a relatively good position of a soldier in here. Thus started his exploration of the cat land and its inhabitants.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公与女友分手后，在猫之国一张柔软的床上醒来。看来他在这里是一名地位还算不错的士兵。于是，他开始探索猫之国及其居民。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
